name: starter-pack
description: Claude Code / Codex Starter Pack: an opinionated set of skills, guard hooks, project kickoff with cloud handoff, a browser studio for new projects, and stack, design, engineering, SRE and docs skills, distilled from real projects.

owner.name: Claude Code / Codex Starter Pack contributors

plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: House rules, guard hooks (secret scans, sileo, no emojis in UI, production gates), guided setup, update-skill and the session-start dependency review.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Process discipline tuned to the owner: shaping work, plans, batched-review execution, systematic debugging, test-first, verification, pre-merge review, simplification, branch finishing, parallel sessions.

plugins.name: kickoff
plugins.description: Start projects the owner's way and hand them to cloud sessions: kickoff interview, stack choice, private repo, cloud kit, handoff brief, verified launch, landing and routines.

plugins.name: stack-web
plugins.description: TypeScript web defaults: Vite + TanStack, Vercel, subdomains on Cloudflare, Resend email, lightweight auth, and Next.js 16 for existing apps.

plugins.name: stack-python
plugins.description: Python agentic backends: Pydantic AI patterns, Temporal patterns, Postgres and Qdrant, FastAPI, reliable LLM calls and LiveKit voice agents.

plugins.name: design-studio
plugins.description: Approve an HTML preview before building, modern-minimal UI rules, browser verification at four widths, guided demo decks and showcase READMEs.

plugins.name: engineering-craft
plugins.description: System design with ADRs, distributed-systems hardening, contract-first APIs, LLM feature design and evals, QA passes, security review, test planning, PR review replies.

plugins.name: ops-and-sre
plugins.description: CI with pinned actions, safe releases and migrations, incidents with a live timeline, SLOs and burn-rate alerts, instrumentation, runbooks and VPS deploys.

plugins.name: interactive-demos
plugins.description: Turn a repository into a verified click-through product demo with the Animated Technical Interactive connector.

plugins.name: stack-connectors
plugins.description: MCP connectors for the stack: Vercel, Cloudflare API and docs, Resend, Logfire, Temporal docs, Context7, Prisma and Chrome DevTools.

plugins.name: docs-and-data
plugins.description: Word documents, spreadsheets with live formulas, slide decks, PDFs, tabular data analysis and in-depth research with citations.

plugins.name: toolbelt
plugins.description: Third-party tools kept and synced from upstream with their MIT licences: graphify, the MulmoTerminal skills, and REA reverse engineering with its MCP server.
